# Ironworks Metal & Building Supply

> Locally owned metal building supplier in Morrill, Nebraska, serving Nebraska, Wyoming, Colorado, and South Dakota within 300 miles of Scottsbluff. Ironworks supplies code-compliant post-frame buildings, cold-form steel kits, and red iron building packages, and rolls its own metal panels and trim in-house. Customers design their building in 3D, then a local builder reviews the design and provides a code-compliant quote (typically within 24 hours).

## What Ironworks builds and supplies
- Post-Frame Buildings — versatile system for ag, commercial, and residential; ag barns, equipment storage, commercial shops and warehouses, residential garages; engineered for local wind and snow loads.
- Cold-Form Steel Kits — precision-engineered steel framing kits for commercial and residential builds; high strength-to-weight; fast, predictable assembly.
- Red Iron Buildings — pre-engineered structural steel for large commercial and industrial builds; clear-span up to 300'; volume pricing available.
- Panels & Trim — 26 & 29 gauge panels in stock; custom panel profiles and trim rolled in-house on Ironworks' own sheet-metal roller.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.ironworksbuildingsupply.com/): Overview, building systems, how the design-and-review process works, gallery, and service area.
- [Contractor Job Specification Review](https://www.ironworksbuildingsupply.com/contractors.html): For regional contractors and roofers — send an active or upcoming job (profile, gauge, color, lengths, trim) for a specification review and reorder-ready pricing.
- [Building Project Fit Check](https://www.ironworksbuildingsupply.com/get-a-quote.html): For building buyers — share intended use, site status, dimensions, timeline, and decision/financial path; a local builder reviews it for your project location and follows up with a next step.
- [3D Building Designer](https://www.ironworksbuildingsupply.com/3d-designer.html): Supporting tool to configure size, doors, colors, and layout, then send the design to Ironworks for review.
- [Free Hail Damage Inspection](https://www.ironworksbuildingsupply.com/hail-damage-inspection.html): Seasonal, event-driven service for Nebraska Panhandle homeowners with hail damage to windows, exterior doors, or garage doors; includes insurance documentation support.

## How the process works
1. Design It — use the 3D tool to lay out building size, doors, colors, and layout in minutes.
2. Tell Us Where & When — enter zip code, timeline, and details so the building is engineered for local wind loads, snow loads, and building codes.
3. Review With a Local Builder — Ironworks calls you, reviews the design, and provides a code-compliant quote with real options.

## Who Ironworks serves
- Contractors & Roofers — volume pricing, contractor accounts, 26 & 29 gauge panels in stock, red iron and cold-form packages.
- Ranchers & Ag Producers — post-frame ag barns, shops, and equipment storage engineered for local conditions.
- Rural Landowners — personal shops, garages, horse barns, and hobby buildings, with first-timer-friendly guidance.

## Service area
Nebraska, Wyoming, Colorado, and South Dakota — within roughly 300 miles of Scottsbluff, Nebraska.
